payout_quote: The cash value you receive could be anywhere between $5 and $200. Keep in mind that approximately 99% of customers will get stock worth $5. ... You're allowed to sell your gift stock 3 trading days after you claim it. ... If you want to withdraw the proceeds, however, you must keep the cash value of that stock in your account for at least 30 days after claiming it. ... Approximately 99% of participants will receive a cash value of $5, approximately 0.9% of participants will receive a cash value of $10, and approximately 0.1% of participants will receive a cash value of $200.
timing: Stock credited within ~1 week of claiming; sellable after 3 trading days; proceeds withdrawable after 30 days
eligibility: New Robinhood customers (never had a Robinhood individual taxable brokerage account); US residents; account approved and bank/debit card linked; claim within 60 days
steps: Open your first Robinhood individual taxable brokerage account
Get approved and link your bank account or debit card (no deposit required)
Claim your gift stock and pick from the 26 eligible companies
Sell the stock 3 trading days after claiming
Withdraw the proceeds 30 days after claiming
catches: Approximately 99% of people get $5 - the $200 headline is a 1-in-1,000 lottery. Expect $5.
No deposit is required, but you must link a bank account or debit card and pass identity verification.
You cannot sell for 3 trading days and cannot withdraw for 30 days - the reward is locked for a month.
The reward is stock, so its value can move between grant and sale.
Reward is taxable and may be reported on Form 1099.
US residents only; one offer per customer; must claim within 60 days.
biggest_catch: No deposit is required, but 99% of people get exactly $5 in stock - and you can't sell for 3 trading days or withdraw for 30 days. The $200 version happens to about 1 person in 1,000.
